instance_description:
Setting: 2026 personal health maintenance for a Baltimore elementary school speech-language pathologist balancing classroom sessions, paperwork blocks, commuting, and home recovery routines.
Scope: Covers nonurgent appointment preparation, saved professional guidance, voice care, hydration, visual breaks, hand and shoulder conditioning, school-day meals, sleep routines, accessibility supports, and supply checks.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can later store Maeve-related context, established guidance, and routine logs; blank TXT files can hold guidance, checklists, appointment notes, and supply summaries.
Exclusions: No diagnosis, treatment choice, medication changes, emergency triage, clinical advice for students, workplace compliance rulings, or contacting providers or school staff without explicit Scenario permission.
personal_description:
Identity: Maeve Iolana Pierce is a 42-year-old elementary school speech-language pathologist living in Baltimore, Maryland, throughout 2026.
Responsibilities: Maeve manages personal appointments, voice-friendly school-day habits, ergonomic documentation routines, hydration and meal planning, sleep consistency, stretching and conditioning, accessibility tools, and routine replenishment of personal health supplies.
Authority: Maeve may organize records, set reminders, compare personal and school schedules, follow saved clinician, voice therapist, physical therapist, dietitian, or trainer guidance, and choose ordinary logistics within established plans.
Restrictions: Maeve does not ask the agent to diagnose symptoms, select treatments, change prescriptions, evaluate urgent concerns, or message clinicians, administrators, coworkers, families, or students unless a Scenario explicitly allows it.
